partial_scope.root: not an event of the outcome: the experiment retains no labelled Beacon root (the Extract entry from which the Beacon root is expanded sits unlabelled in the shared HMAC cache, PqxdhServerAuthNative.sourceRoot, and the established ratchet kernel is derived from the root, but no field of the outcome is the Beacon root, so root equality is not a readout); inside the ServerAuth run of each R_c non-failure includes root agreement, and eps_A1 sums upper bounds on those failure probabilities, but transferring this to the experiment's own roots needs the unbuilt state-carrying coupling (R-b), so no root guarantee about this experiment is claimed, not even informally at eps_A1; informal negative control: before the AEAD the Beacon checks the CTX commitment T* = BLAKE2b(K, N, A, T, LE64(seq), LE64(kid)) over its chain-derived key and nonce (beaconcrypt/src/ratchet.rs:456-466, build_commitment at 553-567), so with an AEAD that ignores its key and nonce, and on a positive-probability BLAKE2b-ROM collision of the commitment, an adversary can replace the KEM ciphertext in the response the Server built for c's own accept by a fresh encapsulation to c's PQ key (the key-ID binding is only LE64 of the assigned key ID, beaconcrypt-core/src/pqxdh.rs:579-590), giving a pinned match with all ten fields and different roots
partial_scope.payload_and_assigned_key_id: outside the eleven fields; not stated
partial_scope.identity_index: the ten-field forms are at identity index 0 (pinned_agree uses positional session handles); ce_a1 itself holds at every index
owner_options: R-a (recommended): accept root only inside R_c

R-b: an observationally extended game logging (owner, root) at each Beacon finish, with an erasure lemma and a state-carrying coupling of the CE-A1 chain; 12 to 30 agent-days; the claim would be about the extended game

R-b-prime (R-b with a prime in the guide; added by the review fix pass): a weaker kernel-lineage event on PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game itself (owner c's ratchet kernel descends, through c's own record traffic, from the initial kernel of the root the Server logged for the matched handle); no game extension or erasure lemma, but the same state-carrying coupling, the bulk of R-b's estimate; not estimated separately
partial_scope.coincidence: on the support at index 0, A1NoAgreement coincides with A1NoPinnedMatch (noAgreement_iff): the theorem adds no probability content; its content is the support-level agreement of the ten fields read from the experiment's final state (each party's state and the transcript) whenever the public pinned match holds

fields.beacon_side: beaconFields: owners[c] pin, identity key of its identity seed, pinnedKeyId, establishedAd (stored 153-byte AD); publishedKeys of the first published bundle
fields.extra: FieldsAgree also requires the registration ID in server.consumed
rust: server.rs:458-475 first seal with candidate associated data
server.rs:218-222 later AD recomputed with build_associated_data
fields.read_from: the experiment's final state, that is each party's state and the transcript: the Server-side beaconIdentity, initKex, registrationId, prekey, oneTime and pqKey are public-reader decodings of the accept bytes in the transcript, and the Beacon-side initKex, registrationId, prekey, oneTime and pqKey combine the owner's identity key with its first published bundle in the transcript
fields.state_level_beyond_ce_a1: the associated data of the Server's first logged seal context equals the Beacon's stored 153-byte associated data; the Beacon's pinned key ID equals the Server's key ID; the accepted identity key is the owner's identity-seed key; the registration ID is in the Server's consumed list (the key equality is a conjunct of PinnedMatchAt, the Beacon pin equals the binding premise, and the origin is c on both sides by construction)

premises: exactly those of PqxdhDeploymentServerAuth.ce_a1 at index 0 (KemBound, Phase1ReadBack, Phase2ReadBack, FrameReadBack, ReadWritable, X25519ClassLaw, X25519ScalarSpread, SourceFullCorrect, HasAttachedVerificationAdapter, budget.Respects, ReductionCaps) and, for the billed and production forms, those of ce_a1_billed and the production ce_a1 forms; the support lemmas use only Phase1ReadBack and Phase2ReadBack
